{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Thermal base layer, slim cut, hip length, charcoal grey (#4A4F57), fine merino wool
Fine-knit turtleneck sweater, regular cut, hip length, deep burgundy (#6D2B3A), merino wool blend
Straight-leg trousers, full length with a slight break at the ankle, dark navy (#1F2A44), heavy wool twill
Thermal tights worn under the trousers, opaque, ankle length, black (#1A1A1A), brushed fleece-lined fabric
Long coat, tailored cut, below the knee, dark camel (#8B6B4A), dense wool-cashmere blend, with a hood-free high collar
Insulated ankle boots, low block heel, waterproof with a grippy rubber sole, black (#1C1C1C), treated leather with a wool lining
Wool socks, mid-calf, heather grey (#8C8F94), merino blend
Knit scarf, wide and long, oatmeal (#CFC2AC), soft lambswool
Knit beanie, close-fitting, charcoal (#3B3E45), wool with a fleece lining
Lined gloves, wrist length, black (#161616), leather with a cashmere lining
Tote bag, structured, medium size, black (#1D1D1D), water-resistant coated leather

This outfit keeps you warm through a 20-minute walk in deep frost and snow while still reading as polished office wear. The burgundy turtleneck with navy wool trousers is a neat, business-ready pairing, and the long camel coat adds a smart layer over it. The waterproof boots with grippy soles handle snow and road salt, and the treated leather wipes clean when you arrive. You can take off the beanie, scarf and gloves at the door, and you are left in a tidy knit and trousers for the workday."}
